cases.query: I want a 4-day training plan to lose weight with strength training.
cases.reference: A 4-day push/pull/legs training plan supporting fat loss should apply progressive resistance training 3-4 days per week, since this is shown to support fat loss outcomes, while matching training volume to recovery capacity and activity level. Protein intake should stay near 1.6-2.2 g/kg/day to preserve lean mass during the deficit. For this profile, daily targets are approximately 2288 calories, 153g protein, 275g carbs, and 64g fat, across 4 training days.

cases.query: Build muscle with a hypertrophy training plan and macro targets.
cases.reference: A 4-day hypertrophy training plan for muscle gain should center on compound lifts such as squat, bench press, and deadlift performed 2-3 times per week each, since this supports strength gains in intermediate lifters, with progressive overload (adding load or reps over time) as the primary driver of long-term adaptation. A modest caloric surplus of 200-300 calories above maintenance supports lean muscle gain while limiting fat gain. For this profile, daily targets are approximately 2393 calories, 136g protein, 314g carbs, and 66g fat, across 4 training days.

cases.query: Calculate my macros for a cutting phase with gym training.
cases.reference: For a cutting phase with 5-day gym training, a moderate caloric deficit of 15-20% below maintenance combined with structured resistance training supports fat loss while preserving strength. Protein intake above 1.6 g/kg bodyweight helps preserve lean mass during the deficit, and higher daily step counts / non-exercise activity (NEAT) meaningfully contribute to total energy expenditure. For this profile, daily targets are approximately 2700 calories, 162g protein, 344g carbs, and 75g fat, across 5 training days.

cases.query: Help me recomposition - keep strength while slowly losing a bit of fat, training 4 days a week.
cases.reference: For a body recomposition approach over 4 training days, a moderate caloric deficit of 15-20% below maintenance combined with structured resistance training supports slow fat loss while preserving strength, and protein intake above 1.6 g/kg bodyweight helps preserve lean mass. Daily non-exercise activity (NEAT) also meaningfully contributes to total energy expenditure. For this profile, daily targets are approximately 2348 calories, 158g protein, 283g carbs, and 65g fat, across 4 training days.
